title: Constructible sheaves are finitely presented in the category of sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $\mathcal F$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of the category $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ of sheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\mathcal I$ be a small filtered category, $i\mapsto\mathcal G_i$ a diagram $\mathcal I\to\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and $(\mathcal G,(c_i)_i)$ a colimit of it in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then the canonical map

$$
 \theta_{\mathcal F}:\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Mor}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G_i)\longrightarrow
 \operatorname{Mor}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)
$$

(colimit of sets; on the $i$-th term $g\mapsto c_i\circ g$) is a bijection; equivalently, every morphism $\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ is $c_i\circ g$ for some $i$ and some $g:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G_i$, and if $c_i\circ g=c_{i'}\circ g'$ for $g:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G_i$, $g':\mathcal F\to\mathcal G_{i'}$, there are morphisms $\alpha:i\to k$, $\alpha':i'\to k$ of $\mathcal I$ with $\mathcal G(\alpha)\circ g=\mathcal G(\alpha')\circ g'$.
(*Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Lemma 59.73.8, Tag [09Z4](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09Z4).* Stacks states it for any Noetherian ring $\Lambda$ and also for sheaves of sets and of abelian groups; it is stated here for sheaves of modules over a finite $\Lambda$, the generality of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].)

proof.text: Use the affine-free finite presentation with Noetherian coefficients. The free-Yoneda and sheafification adjunctions identify Hom from an affine free sheaf with its affine sections, naturally in the target. Affine etale sections preserve filtered colimits, as does the module forgetful functor, so each affine free sheaf is finitely presentable. A finite coproduct and then the cokernel of a map between those finite coproducts are finite colimits of finitely presentable objects. Finite colimits preserve finite presentability, proving the assertion. This argument allows the empty affine families in the zero-object case.

blueprint_proof_text:
Two recorded inputs are used. First, a constructible sheaf of
$\Lambda$-modules is a finite colimit of representable sheaves $h_W$ with
$W\to X$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated (Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology,
Lemma 59.73.5, Tag [09Y9](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09Y9), whose
proof argues by a finite stratification of $X$ and induction on the number of
strata). Second, for such a $W$ the sections $\mathcal
G(W)=\operatorname{Mor}(h_W,\mathcal G)$ of a sheaf commute with filtered
colimits of sheaves (Stacks Project, Sites, Lemma 7.17.7, Tag
[0738](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0738): a quasi-compact
quasi-separated object of a site is coherent). Colimits in the first variable
are computed on the presentation, and the two assertions of the statement are
respectively the existence and the uniqueness of the factorization, so the two
inputs give the bijection.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 09Z4 (etale-cohomology.tex lemma-constructible-is-compact) and its inputs 09Y9 (sets), 095N (modules), 09YT (abelian) and Sites 0738. Statement restricted from Noetherian to finite Lambda and to sheaves of modules (the DAG's constructible-sheaf definition is for finite Lambda; the only user, lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaf-colimit-constructible, is for finite Lambda and modules); the 'equivalently' clause made precise. stmt_deps: def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes (complexes, unused) replaced by def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf, plus scheme conventions, module category and colimit. The blueprint proof cited 09Y9 (sheaves of sets, coequalizers of h_W) for modules; the Stacks proof for modules uses 095N (cokernel of finite sums of j_{U!}Lambda_U), which is followed here. Proof in 4 steps: reformulation (filtered colimits of sets, Mathlib leaf), presentation (new node 095N), j_{U!}Lambda_U finitely presentable via Hom = sections (free Yoneda leaf + sheafification) and new node for Sites 0738 on qcqs etale objects, finite colimits of finitely presentable objects (new Mathlib leaf CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable_of_isColimit at aleph_0). slopmaster2 has AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isFinitelyPresentable_of_isConstructibleSheaf (own sorry, WeilConjectures/ConstructibleSheaf/FinitePushforward.lean:94-97, docstring names this node) with IsNoetherianRing Lambda and finite stalks; node lean_audit left for the lead.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let $\Lambda$ be a
Noetherian ring, let $F$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on
$X_{\Et}$, and let $G=\varinjlim_iG_i$ be a filtered colimit of sheaves of
$\Lambda$-modules. Then the canonical map

$$
 \varinjlim_i\operatorname{Mor}(F,G_i)\longrightarrow
 \operatorname{Mor}(F,G)
$$

is a bijection; equivalently, every morphism $F\to G$ factors through one of
the $G_i$, and any two such factorizations agree after passing to a common
refinement of the index.
